item.subject: science
item.stem:
Bina traces food after it leaves the stomach and enters the small intestine. The small intestine receives digestive secretions, including basic pancreatic juice from the pancreas. The liver also sends a secretion. Carbohydrates, proteins and fats are major food components. Digested nutrients can enter blood vessels in the small-intestine wall.

Which statement is correct?

options.A: The small intestine receives digestive secretions, uses basic pancreatic juice to help neutralise acidic food, digests major food components, and absorbs digested nutrients into blood.
options.B: The liver secretes pancreatic juice into the small intestine.
options.C: Undigested carbohydrates, proteins and fats pass directly through the small-intestine wall into blood.
options.D: During absorption, digested nutrients move from blood vessels into the small intestine.
